comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: The above recipe is correct but to those planning to make Nocturnal Phantom Paneling, please be EXTREMELY careful as the same base item (Celeb. Phantom Panel) can also be used to make Ceremonial Phantom Paneling and that is perhaps the most hideous, eye-bleedingly awful panel in the entire game. Do NOT make that one by accident and waste your rare/expensive Celeb Phantom while trying to make this lovely midnight black panel. You have been warned... Cheers.

Recipe: Making Nocturnal Phantom Paneling
Required Skill/Rank: Handicrafts r16
Ingredients:
Improved Steel Sheet x50
Special Ship Paint x2
Celebratory Phantom Paneling
Produced Goods: Nocturnal Phantom Paneling

Note: Artisan's Skills 1 skill reduces above ingredients by 10%

Panel Effect:
Acceleration Up in the Sea of Wonders 1
Reduced damage from phantom beasts 1

Stacks with Ship Lights in Foggy Seas / Monster Battle Armament skills.
